macro.text: US ordered diplomats out of Saudi Arabia as Houthi strikes raised fears of wider Iran conflict
Oil rose as Mideast tensions and the Saudi diplomat pullout stoked supply-disruption fears
Gold fell near $4,115 as Saudi attacks fed inflation worries and Fed-path uncertainty
China's CSI 300 slid into a bear market, down 20% from its June peak
Bank of Korea held rates, with an upbeat outlook pointing to future hikes
France's debt strains stayed in focus as a key macro risk for European markets

corporate.note: Tesla beat Q3 estimates but shares fell as Musk gave no new update on a SpaceX merger
Meta's ad business beat forecasts and its Muse AI monetization roadmap lifted shares
IBM beat on earnings as CEO Krishna touted 'Super Intelligence' AI traction with clients
Southwest cut its 2026 profit forecast, the third airline this month to do so on fuel costs
Meta was ordered to pay $25 billion in New Mexico over the Cambridge Analytica scandal
CoreWeave shares down 29% in October as bond yields spiked and CDS spreads widened
Apple will have only limited iPhone Duo supply in stores Friday
GM is targeting roughly two-year vehicle development cycles via AI and software
Musk's public push for a Tesla-SpaceX merger may complicate rather than help the talks
Cloudflare saw millions of exploit attempts after a critical PHP vulnerability disclosure

frontPage.watch: Watch for further Mideast headlines driving oil and gold, with more mega-cap earnings and credit stress at AI-linked names in focus.
